dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: On closer inspection... isn't it just a nutritional supplement?

dialogues.speaker: Capulin
dialogues.text: Well, there are nutritional supplements and then there are "nutritional supplements." I, the respectable, respected Capulin, rely on my reputation to do business. If my supplement wasn't the best around, would I be able to stand here every day and praise it so?

dialogues.speaker: Capulin
dialogues.text: Just look at those loyal customers, each one a living, breathing endorsement! We don't cheat people around here! If you buy my tonic and aren't satisfied, why, I'll dismantle my stand tomorrow!
